name: Hold ready for pickup
subject: Ready to collect at [% branch.branchname %]
about: Sent when a hold is confirmed as waiting at its pickup library, to a patron who chose 'Hold filled' in their messaging preferences. Koha sends the print version instead when the patron chose email or SMS but has no address or number for it. A patron who ticked 'Digests only' gets HOLDDGST instead.
